denominator: Source Table 2 global 2020 validation sample: 22,719 points. Producer accuracy = correct / reference-class points; user accuracy = correct / mapped-class points. Stratified sample, not demonstrated area weighting.

coverage.population: Global classification benchmark, nine classes including non-wetland background
coverage.included: 18 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: No live wetland-loss alerts, conservation outcomes, national accuracy estimates or raster footprints
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Class-specific accuracy differs substantially. Validation uses 22,719 stratified points and discards points with low expert agreement, which can bias evaluation toward easier cases. Published parenthetical uncertainty retained without assuming it is a 95% confidence interval. The product spans 2000–2022; this table evaluates 2020 only.

transform.description: Transcribed selected published factual findings into a normalized long table; values retain source precision. No interpolation or score normalization.
transform.validation: Row-level source locators; numerical bounds and schema checked locally; independent review pending.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
